offers_products.reason: Produces Portland, Portland-limestone and masonry cements; also ready-mixed concrete and building materials distribution.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured cement and concrete products, not work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Cement and ready-mixed concrete sold to contractors, concrete producers and building suppliers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells cement to ready-mix producers, block makers, contractors and building material dealers in the Midwest.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of cement and concrete by the same ready-mix and construction customers, though project-driven.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cement demand follows new construction and infrastructure, which can be postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Cement and concrete are bulk commodity materials bought frequently in repeated deliveries.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured cement from a plant, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly regional ready-mix producers, block makers and contractors, many small or mid-sized.

asset_heavy.reason: Cement plant, quarries, kilns, terminals and ready-mix plants require heavy ongoing capital investment.

notes: Ready-mixed concrete and other building materials segments inferred from background knowledge; website text covers only cement.
